title: Optimize row deduplication lookup
constraints: Preserve DISTINCT and set operation deduplication order
rationale: Executor::deduplicate_rows checked HashSet::contains before HashSet::insert for each row. Using the boolean result of insert avoids a second hash table lookup while preserving first-seen row order.
steps: Replace contains plus insert with a single HashSet::insert call
Keep pushing the original row only when insert reports it is newly seen
Verify SELECT DISTINCT and UNION behavior
expected_impact: Reduces hash table lookups in DISTINCT and set operation deduplication paths.
